hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"); [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" != "main" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "Cannot edit on main branch. Create a feature branch first."}' >&2; exit 2; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && FILE_PATH="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ \.py$ ]]; then ruff format "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && echo '{"feedback": "Formatted with ruff.", "suppressOutput": true}' || echo '{"feedback": "Formatting skipped.", "suppressOutput": true}'; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && FILE_PATH="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ \.py$ ]] && [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ \.test\.py$|^tests/ ]]; then echo '{"feedback": "Running tests..."}' >&2; pytest "$FILE_PATH" -v --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
